APAC: 0.5 TB->1 TB, 1 TB->2 TB, 2 TB->4 TB — i.e. APAC is 1/2.5 of the US figure. This is the Asia option's real trap: the Tokyo/Singapore plans cost the same as US/EU and give 40% of the traffic.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Root KVM on a 10 Gbps port, which is unusually fast for this price class. Ceiling of 2 TB per VM means 10 VMs for 20 TB — workable for the chunk-and-replicate pattern but not for a single 10 TiB working set.
